out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is in poor repair: walk in cooler gasket at the bottom corner allowing for visible light from the outside of the cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Person in charge will repair cooler before next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the floor at back prep area and the ceiling on the cook line is not maintained in good repair. Floor is exposed to the subfloor, allowing for the build up of debris.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Person in charge will repair floor and ceiling tiles before next routine inspection.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pizza sauce (47F) on prep table
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Person in charge placed sauce in cooler.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: pizza sauce (marked 3/28) in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. Person in charge discarded pizza sauce.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: frozen meatballs thawing on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC placed meatballs under refrigeration.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: exterior of refrigeration units.
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PIC to ensure exterior surfaces of equipment are cleaned.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 door flat top refrigerator between kitchen areas.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC will obtain a thermometer for the inside of the refrigerator.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. HOT WATER TEMPERATURE WAS 88F AND 92F AT HAND SINKS IN KITCHEN AND PREP AREA.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT PLUMBING SERVICE AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Surfaces of the CAN OPENER were in contact with non-time/temperature control for safety food items that were observed soiled with accumulations of grime and debris.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at any time when contamination may have occurred. BADDPIZZA (Inspection Date: 10/31/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. HOT WATER TEMPERATURE AT 3-COMPARTMENT SINK WAS 102F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT PLUMBING SERVICE AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A TYPE OF UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED THE PICTURE OF AN APPROVED SPLITTER AND BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE AND ASSEMBLY EXAMPLES WITH THE CFM. PLEASE REPLACE THE UNAPPROVED SPLITTER WITH AN APPROVED ONE WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WIHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THAT THE AREAS BEHIND AND UNDER THE EQUIPMENT UNITS AND STORAGE RACKS ARE IN NEED OF CLEANING TO REDUCE THE BUILD UP OF GREASE AND DEBRIS.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
